description.value: Gong Cha is a globally recognized bubble tea brand with over 1,650 stores across 20 countries and 50+ locations in Canada. The Granville Street location sits in the heart of downtown Vancouver, offering customizable milk teas, fruit teas, and other cold beverages with indoor seating. It is a convenient stop for cyclists moving through the city centre, with takeout available and vegetarian-friendly menu options.
